findings.problem: New in v2: the circumposition 'tot … toe' is a fixed chunk the reader meets for the first time here; it is not a restricted construction and every part is known (tot A1, rand A2, toe A1, vol A2), so it reads as 'full up to the edge'.
findings.evidence: no R-id applies; lexicon: rand A2, vol A2, kaft A2, hard A1; sentence is 20 words, one finite verb, no subordinate clause
findings.required_fix: None. Keep (this is the brim image the v1 meaning review asked for).

findings.fragment: twee rijen sciencefiction met een zachte kaft
findings.problem: New in v2: 'met een zachte kaft' modifies the genre noun 'sciencefiction' used as a mass noun; a native reads it as 'paperback SF' without stumbling, and the parallel with 'met een harde kaft' is deliberate.
findings.evidence: mirrors EN 'paperback science fiction' (also genre as mass noun); zacht A1, kaft A2; 11 words
findings.required_fix: None required. If the cohesion editor wants the noun explicit: 'twee rijen sciencefictionboeken met een zachte kaft' (compound of known parts).
